chunks: Muḥammad ibn Marwān narrated from him, peace be upon him, that he said:
My father, peace be upon him, left sixty slaves and instructed that one-third of them be freed. So I cast lots among them, brought out twenty, and then freed them.

key_terms.أَوْصَى: he made a bequest or final instruction

ai.seo_question: How was a will to free one-third of sixty slaves carried out in this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith reports the execution of a bequest to emancipate one-third of a group of owned slaves left by Imam's father عليه السلام. It shows the use of casting lots to determine which individuals would be freed when the will specified a fraction of a larger group.
